name: Malvern Day Camp
description_short: Day camp in Glen Mills for ages 5 to 14 in Mini, Junior and Senior camps plus a counselor in training program. Campers swim twice a day with optional lessons and rotate through sports, waterfront, nature, STEAM, archery, the rock wall and adventure course; families choose 2, 3 or 5 days a week for 3 to 10 weeks.

fees.name: Lunch
fees.note: Ordered in the parent portal by the Thursday before each week. Two snacks a day are served.

refund_policy_summary: The $100 registration fee and $200 deposit are non-refundable. Tuition paid before March 15 can be refunded; no refunds for weeks cancelled after April 1, 2027, or for absences or early withdrawal.
notes: Weekly price is the 5 day rate when registering for 5 weeks or fewer. 2027 rates: Mini and Junior (5 to 9) $375 for 2 days, $500 for 3 days, $610 for 5 days; Senior and CIT (10 to 14) $405, $510, $610. Six weeks or more: 3 days $465 or $475, 5 days $555. Rates subject to change. 10% discounts for Malvern School families, CITs, siblings and military. Camp 9 to 4 with care from 7 AM to 6 PM included. Van transportation from five Malvern School locations (Downingtown, Frazer, Lionville, Malvern, Newtown Square).
